# OCA repositories providing the free replacements for Odoo Enterprise features.
# One "<branch> <url>" per line. Fetch them with: scripts/fetch-oca.sh
#
# The clones themselves are deliberately not committed: they are ~1.4 GB, almost
# all of it .git metadata, and they are reproducible from this list.

18.0 https://github.com/OCA/account-reconcile.git
18.0 https://github.com/OCA/bank-payment.git
# Importing the bank's own file is what makes reconciliation automatic:
# without it every line is typed by hand and nobody reconciles for long.
